# Brian Butler | eXp Realty

> Brian Butler, REALTOR® (eXp Realty, License #SA701819000) serves home buyers and sellers in San Tan Valley and Florence, Arizona.

Brian Butler is a licensed Arizona real estate agent with eXp Realty, specializing in residential real estate in San Tan Valley and Florence, Arizona. Four years of experience serving buyers and sellers in these markets.

- [San Tan Heights (San Tan Valley)](https://thebutlerrealty.com/neighborhoods/san-tan-valley/san-tan-heights): San Tan Heights — a large foothills community in western San Tan Valley with mountain views, miles of trails, and San Tan Heights Elementary inside the community.
- [Copper Basin (San Tan Valley)](https://thebutlerrealty.com/neighborhoods/san-tan-valley/copper-basin): Copper Basin is an 847-acre village-center community in San Tan Valley with its own YMCA, Copper Basin Elementary, fire station, and 20-acre park on Main Street.
- [Ironwood Crossing (San Tan Valley)](https://thebutlerrealty.com/neighborhoods/san-tan-valley/ironwood-crossing): Ironwood Crossing by Fulton Homes at Ironwood and Ocotillo — aquatics center with a 7,000 sq ft heated pool, 20 parks, and a charter school inside the community.
- [Circle Cross Ranch (San Tan Valley)](https://thebutlerrealty.com/neighborhoods/san-tan-valley/circle-cross-ranch): Circle Cross Ranch in San Tan Valley — a Florence Unified elementary school and Empire Park inside the community, walking trails, and one of the closer drives to Queen Creek, Gilbert and Mesa.
- [Skyline Ranch (San Tan Valley)](https://thebutlerrealty.com/neighborhoods/san-tan-valley/skyline-ranch): Skyline Ranch at the base of the San Tan Mountains — Mediterranean-style homes, Skyline Ranch Elementary, and the gated acre-lot enclave of Encanto Real.
- [Rancho Bella Vista (San Tan Valley)](https://thebutlerrealty.com/neighborhoods/san-tan-valley/rancho-bella-vista): Rancho Bella Vista and Rancho Bella Vista South — 2003-2009 homes between Hunt Highway and Gantzel, surrounded by farmland, with mountain views and a lower-profile HOA.
- [Anthem at Merrill Ranch — Parkside (Florence)](https://thebutlerrealty.com/neighborhoods/florence/anthem-at-merrill-ranch-parkside): Parkside at Anthem at Merrill Ranch — the all-ages side of Florence's Merrill Ranch master plan, with the community park, water amenities, and Poston Butte golf.
- [Sun City Anthem at Merrill Ranch (Florence)](https://thebutlerrealty.com/neighborhoods/florence/sun-city-anthem-merrill-ranch): Sun City Anthem at Merrill Ranch — Florence's 55-plus section of Merrill Ranch, with a 48,000 sq ft clubhouse, Poston Butte golf, and access to the wider Merrill Ranch amenities.
- [Florence Gardens (Florence)](https://thebutlerrealty.com/neighborhoods/florence/florence-gardens): Florence Gardens is an established 55-plus community in Florence where homeowners own their land — 1,219 lots, clubhouse, pools, pickleball, and a 9-hole executive golf course, with no lot rent.
- [Historic Downtown Florence (Florence)](https://thebutlerrealty.com/neighborhoods/florence/historic-downtown-florence): Living in and around historic Florence — Main Street, the 1891 Pinal County Courthouse, McFarland State Historic Park, historic homes, and the original town subdivisions.

No decision is expected before December.
